_comment: Characters the handwritten reference sheets practise. Two kinds of entry, kept apart on purpose: textCharacters can be reworked with point patches because the face already draws them; radicalStudies are stroke studies (participate in 你/我/这/阳 ...), not text, so they are never counted as text coverage. tools/glyph_audit.py checks this list against the prepared faces and tools/preview.py renders it.
strokeRules: 去钩：竖/竖弯/弯钩不做出钩，收笔走直线
平辶：走之底写成一横加短尾，不做顿折
圆头：可见端头收成半圆，被交叉笔画盖住的端头保持平切
点成圆：独立点写作小圆点，不用尖角
方日：日/口/白类内框写成方形，四角不做圆弧外扩
等粗：同一字内笔画粗细一致，不做书法提按
